open_exceptions.detail: petcare_execution/EVIDENCE/MANIFEST.json declares 315 files; 169 are tracked by git and 146 are not. The manifest was generated over a working tree, so the 146 are __pycache__/*.pyc, *.bak.<timestamp> files and a baseline_input/ tree. No cited EVIDENCE artefact is among them - the custody index's 14 cited paths are all tracked and hash-bound.
open_exceptions.discovered_by: the first clean CI checkout. Every local run passed because all 146 sit in the working copy of anyone who ran the pipeline that produced them.
open_exceptions.guard: tests/governance/test_canonical_register_integrity.py pins the count at exactly 146 and asserts none of them is an evidence artefact.
open_exceptions.remediation_constraint: Regenerating the manifest over tracked files only would change a dated snapshot's bytes; that is a separate decision with its own evidence. Do not edit it to make a test pass.

exception_list_semantics: This list is append-only. A resolved exception keeps its row and changes its status, so the history of what was once open stays legible. Read `status`, never mere membership.
